title: Disciplinary Deduction Types — Create / Edit
overviewHtml: The deductions a disciplinary action can carry — a number of days' or hours' pay, a fixed amount, or a percentage. Disciplinary types list which deduction applies to which offence.

fields.label: Code
fields.rules: Optional. Left blank, the next number is assigned when the record is saved. Must be unique in this list.
fields.html:
What it is. A short code that identifies this item in its list.

Example. 001

fields.label: NameEn
fields.html: What it is. The item's name in English.

fields.label: NameAr
fields.html: What it is. The item's name in Arabic.

fields.label: DisciplinaryDeductionUnit
fields.rules: Required. One of: Days, Hours, Fixed Amount, Percentage.
fields.html: What it is. What the deduction value is measured in.

fields.label: DeductionValue
fields.html:
What it is. How much is deducted, in the chosen unit.

Example. 1 with the unit Days, for one day's pay

Why it matters. For a percentage it must be between 0 and 100.
fields.adminHtml: Stored only: no payroll calculation reads the unit or the value at present, so recording a disciplinary action does not reduce pay by itself.
